images.after: Rules on reviews have got stricter
images.title: Review and disclosure checks
images.alt: Checklist for affiliate reviews: no fake or AI reviews, no false claims of testing or independence, and disclosures placed next to recommendations.
images.caption: The FTC rule on consumer reviews took effect on October 21, 2024.
images.note: This is not legal advice. Read the FTC pages linked in the article.

items: No fake reviews, including AI-written ones from people who don't exist
Never write "I tested this" about a product you haven't handled
Don't present a site you control as offering independent reviews
Put the disclosure close to the recommendation
Don't rely on the words "affiliate link" alone
